name: ~Song of Homunculus~
summary: The tale of a rakish lump of clay, given life at the beginning of the world, who wanders here and there rummaging in dumpsters for rare garbage, befriending a criminal hamster, getting involved in the political affairs of the bigfeet of Moonlantis, etc. A lovely game for those RPG fans who enjoy sidequests, secrets, and a very large number of available party members.
